content_of_post_to_comment:
I waste a lot of time watching garbage on YouTube i dont care about.

I also drink alcohol because i have an addiction.

My main problem is that those 2 things support each other. I cant avoid YouTube when drunk. And watching YouTube makes drinking too complimentary. But of course being addicted to YouTube and alcohol for a long time it is super difficult to find joy and curiosity in other activities.

I can't "just do it".

Hoping maybe this sub can offer me help?
comment: The alcohol/YouTube pairing sounds like a habit loop, so trying to replace both at once with “fun” activities may be brutal. It might be easier to break the pairing first: no YouTube while drinking, even if that means being bored. Once the two stop reinforcing each other, finding other things enjoyable may get a little less impossible.
